decisions.story_title: IDScan Data Breach Exposes 153 Million Driver's Licenses
decisions.reason: Massive identity document breach confirmed by BleepingComputer. 153 million stolen driver's licenses is a significant identity theft risk.

decisions.story_title: BlueMoon Exploit Kit Targets Chrome and Windows
decisions.reason: Proofpoint-documented exploit kit used by four espionage groups. Chains Chrome V8 vulns (patched Sep 3 and Sep 8) with a Windows privilege escalation. Active exploitation observed.
CVE-2026-88891 (CVSS 8.3) access bypass on 26 of 29 mutating procedures. Real web panel vuln.
CVE-2026-88890 (CVSS 8.5) SQL injection in analytics filter builder. Same product as CVE-2026-88891, merge into one story.
CVE-2026-88889 (CVSS 7.8) command injection in Maven Wrapper manager for Renovate <44.14.7. CI/CD supply chain risk.

decisions.story_title: Check Point VPN Critical Certificate Flaws (CVE-2026-85102, CVE-2026-85103)
decisions.reason: Two critical (CVSS 9.8) VPN certificate handling flaws allowing unauthenticated access. High-impact VPN vendor.
